{{Quote|Bricka Thomor, friend. Purveyor of the finest weapons.|Bricka introduces herself|<ref name="SC" />}}
'''Bricka Thomor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wielu]] selling weapons. She agreed to sell a weapon to the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rook Pryce]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and also provided him with fake information on the location of the criminal [[T'mott Zoat]], for whom he was searching along with the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The information lead Kenobi and Pryce into a trap set up by [[Shon Ti'Ja]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime boss]] whom wanted revenge on Pryce.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I can sell you a blaster, and help you find the Shistavanen.|Bricka offers aid to Kenobi and Pryce.|<ref name="SC" />}}
[[File:ShonTiJa-TheSmugglersCode.jpg|thumb|left|Bricka Thomor sent Pryce and Kenobi into a trap set by Shon Ti'Ja.|150px]]
Bricka Thomor was an [[Merchant/Legends|arms dealer]] who worked in the [[Market Ward]] area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wielu]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] whilst at her stall, she observed the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rook Pryce]] being turned away by a rival weapons merchant, [[Gutodj]], since the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime bosses]] that controlled much of Wielu had forbidden anyone from doing business with the untrustworthy smuggler. Bricka offered to ignore the ban and sell Pryce a blaster as well as information regarding the location of [[T'mott Zoat]], a [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] criminal that Pryce and his new co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], Sal'ma Ben Bobo were searching for.<ref name="SC" />

For a price of 50 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] she handed over the weapon and informed the pair that the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] Crime Boss [[Shon Ti'Ja]] had hired Zoat and the pair could be found on [[Alekie Island]] in the [[Alekie Island menagerie|Menagerie]] built there. Bobo was in fact the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in disguise, and as the pair began to leave for the island she warned him that he ought to know who he was dealing with in terms of Pryce, who had a reputation of not honoring contracts. Thomor however had lied to the pair, and after they left contacted Ti'Ja who had not hired Zoat but was looking for revenge on Pryce, who had sold weapons belonging to the Nautolan to a rival boss named [[Caylagos]]. Ti'Ja then prepared an ambush for the smuggler and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] within the Menagerie but was ultimately bested by them in combat and revealed Thomor's deception.<ref name="SC" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|If you're going to deal on Wielu&hellip;you have to know who your dealing with.|Bricka warns Kenobi of Pryce's unsavory reputation.|<ref name="SC" />}}
Bricka Thomor was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] with [[Color/Legends|fair]] skin, brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. She was willing to lie to Rook Pryce and send him into a trap along with his new co-pilot, although she did warn Kenobi that he should be careful dealing with the smuggler. She possessed a [[Fish/Legends|fish]] shaped [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] on one [[Limb/Legends|arm]] and whilst working at the market wore a pink and purple dress along with a large amount of [[Gold/Legends|golden]] jewellery.<ref name="SC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bricka Thomor first appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: The Smuggler's Code]]'', a digest sized [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] released in [[2013]]. It was written by [[Justin Aclin]] and illustrated by [[Eduardo Ferrara]].
